pr_title: littlefs: fix return code on mount
pr_body:
When littlefs mount fails and there is no formatting requested, the return code must be translated to errno before being passed to the application layer.

Additionally, only log a warning that the FS will be formatted, when the system is not read-only.

Fixes #56378
pr_comments: @de-nordic, thanks for the feedback. All comments addressed

> Minor fixes to release notes, otherwise looks OK

all right, updated notes as suggested.

issue_context.title: fs_mount() don't translate littlefs return code when mount fails and no formatting is requested
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When invoking `fs_mount()` with littlefs as backend and passing the flag `FS_MOUNT_FLAG_NO_FORMAT`, if the mount fails, the littlefs return code it's passed directly to the application without being first translated into errno.

**To Reproduce**
In `tests/subsys/fs/littlefs:test_fs_mkfs`, the flash area is swept before calling `fs_mount()`, hence `lfs_mount()` will return `LFS_ERR_CORRUPT=84`, but it should be instead `EFAULT` (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/subsys/fs/littlefs_fs.c#L102).

For example, to reproduce with `esp32` board (the board I have at hand right now):
`west build -p always -b esp32 tests/subsys/fs/littlefs`
For this board, is needed to create a DT overlay as follow:
```devicetree
/* tests/subsys/fs/littlefs/boards/esp32.overlay */

/delete-node/ &storage_partition;

&flash0 {
	partitions {
		compatible = "fixed-partitions";
		#address-cells = <1>;
		#size-cells = <1>;
		small_partition: partition@250000 {
			label = "small";
			reg = < 0x250000 0x00010000 >;
		};
	};
};
```

**Expected behavior**
All littlefs return code are translated to errno before being passed to the application layer.

**Impact**
Wrong error code returned to application when FS is damaged/corrupted and `tests/subsys/fs/littlefs` failing

**Logs and console output**
